title: Decision 1.0: Towards Open Decision Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18629v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intelligent software needs reusable judgments inside its control flow: selecting an action, testing a condition, or assessing evidence against a rubric. We present Decision 1.0, an open-weight family that turns textual state and runtime-defined questions into typed probability distributions. Its Choice, Noul, and Score interface lets applications specify outcomes at inference time and compose predictions into agents and workflows. Each question produces its candidate distribution without autoregressive text generation. Six models cover bidirectional encoder and causal decoder architectures, including a workflow specialist. Training draws on verifiable tasks, natural-language annotations, and workflow adaptation. On a common decision benchmark, Lux-9B achieves 84.17\% on explicit decisions and 91.25\% on inference, with a weighted overall score of 77.22\%. Results also expose gaps in composition, transfer, and probability calibration. Rel

translated_title: Decision 1.0：迈向开放式决策基础模型
translated_abstract: 智能软件需要在控制流内部进行可复用的判断：选择一个动作、测试一个条件，或依据评分标准评估证据。我们提出 Decision 1.0，这是一个开放权重的模型家族，能够将文本状态和运行时定义的问题转化为类型化的概率分布。其 Choice、Noul 和 Score 接口让应用程序能够在推理时指定输出结果，并将预测组合成智能体和工作流。每个问题都会产生其对应的候选分布，而无需自回归文本生成。六个模型涵盖双向编码器和因果解码器两种架构，其中包括一个工作流专用模型。训练数据来源于可验证任务、自然语言标注以及工作流适配。在一个通用决策基准上，Lux-9B 在显式决策上达到 84.17%，在推理任务上达到 91.25%，加权总分为 77.22%。实验结果还揭示了模型在组合能力、迁移能力和概率校准方面存在的差距。
tldr: Decision 1.0 是首个开放的决策基础模型家族，它能将文本状态和运行时定义的问题直接转化为类型化概率分布，无需自回归生成即可为智能体和工作流提供可复用的判断能力。
en_tdlr: Decision 1.0 is an open-weight family of decision foundation models that converts textual states and runtime-defined questions into typed probability distributions without autoregressive generation, enabling reusable judgments for agents and workflows.
